question: How many mass shootings will the U.S. experience in November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Resolution source's own S3 JSON gives November counts of 33 (2024) and 27 (2025), with November typically a little below October (35->33, 32->27). 2026 is running similar to or slightly above 2025: Sep 2026 = 35 entries, Oct 2026 = 31 through Oct 25 (~37 full-month pace); GVA reports 354 mass shootings through Q3 2026, an increase over 2025. Applying the Nov/Oct seasonal ratio to the Oct 2026 pace gives about 30-32. Spread is Poisson plus level uncertainty plus possible reporting lag by the Dec 4 resolution. Market check: Polymarket/Manifold (harness) and Kalshi (search) — no market found. Counts came from model-assisted reading of the JSON (local parsing was blocked), so they may be off by a few.
calls.dossier:
- Resolves off the Mass Shooting Tracker (massshootingtracker.site) 2026 data, count of incidents dated November 2026. The definition is 4+ shot including the shooter, which is broader than GVA. It does NOT resolve off GVA or Wikipedia. Raw data: S3 JSON mass-shooting-tracker-data.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/2026-data.json (the HTML page renders via JS).
- Event window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-30 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-26, 0% elapsed. Question resolves 2026-12-04, so late additions by the volunteer maintainers could be missing.
- MST JSON, read via model-assisted extraction and possibly off by a few: Sep 2024 = 32, Oct 2024 = 35, Nov 2024 = 33.
- MST JSON 2025: Jul 28, Aug 29, Sep 38, Oct 32, Nov 27, Dec 19. The Nov 2025 incidents were listed individually and add up to 27; six of them fell on 11/2 and five on 11/15.
- MST JSON 2026: Sep 2026 = 35 listed (one extraction pass said 34). Oct 2026 = 31 listed through Oct 25 (another pass said 24), latest entry Oct 25, which scales to about 37 for the full month.
- Nov/Oct ratio: 0.94 (2024), 0.84 (2025).
- Wikipedia 2026 list (GVA definition): 365 mass shootings through Sep 30, 2026. A Trace Q3 2026 summary (via search snippet; the page itself returned 403) says GVA has 354 through Q3 2026, an increase from the previous year.
- Poisson noise alone at a level of about 30 gives SD about 5.5. Weekend clusters (e.g. 6 on one day in Nov 2025) drive month-to-month variance.
- Status quo: November counts in the high 20s to low 30s on MST over the last two years.
- Markets: none found on Polymarket, Manifold, or Kalshi.
- Searched for but not found: GVA official monthly Nov counts for 2023-2025; earlier-year MST November counts (2013-2023).
